title: filenamify output is not NFC-normalized when the replacement is non-NFC (not idempotent)
property: filenamify(filenamify(x, o), o) equals filenamify(x, o); output is always NFC
expected: Output normalized to NFC ('aéb' with U+00E9), so re-applying filenamify returns the same string
actual: Returns 'ae\u0301b' (decomposed); filenamify of that returns 'a\u00E9b', a different string
evidence: Source comment: 'Normalize to NFC first to stabilize byte representation and length calculations across platforms.' The input is NFC-normalized but the replacement is inserted afterwards without normalization, so the stated stabilization goal is not met.
